I'm giving it one star for now because I haven't had the chance to receive treatment at the clinic. This review only covers my experience with the appointment scheduling and queue management.

My suggestion is to improve appointment time management. If there are cases requiring longer than usual or unforeseen circumstances, clients with subsequent appointments should be notified in advance so they can decide whether to wait or reschedule. Leaving clients waiting without any communication is unacceptable.

I had an appointment at 6:30 PM and intended to arrive 10-15 minutes early because I value punctuality and didn't want my appointment to affect other clients.

However, I ended up waiting until approximately 7:40 PM before the clinic informed me that they couldn't perform the teeth scaling and sent me home. I felt this was inappropriate, as I wasted over an hour without receiving treatment or even being informed of the situation while waiting.

If there had been prior communication about delays or potential unavailability, I could have rescheduled or attended to other matters, rather than sitting and waiting without knowing how long I would have to wait.

All the staff were polite and provided good service; there were no problems in that aspect. However, I hope the clinic improves its queue management and communication with clients, as this significantly impacts the overall customer experience.
